messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine_to_five>
Required: between 9 and 5 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_seven>
Backend engineering: 7 years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Let us discuss any ambiguities or mistakes in the requirement before
proceeding with the assessment.

response.text:
The requirement looks mistaken, so I would not treat a match decision as settled yet.

**“Between 9 and 5 years” is reversed.** In ordinary use, “between A and B” expects the lower bound first. As written, a strict reading (at least 9 and at most 5) is an empty range, so nobody could match. The likely intent is **5 to 9 years**.

Other open points, if that fix is right:

- **Inclusivity.** “Between” sometimes excludes the endpoints. It is unclear whether exactly 5 or exactly 9 would count.
- **What counts as the years.** The summary states 7 years of backend engineering on transactional services. That lines up with the role type, but the posting does not say whether only paid, full-time, or post-graduation years count.

If you confirm the range is 5–9 years inclusive, the stated 7 years would fall inside it. If the bounds stay as written, there is no coherent requirement to match.
